summary: Saturated conductor support and Galois-fibre constraints exclude 39 of 40 indicator/Gram branches. The remaining V=4 branch has an exact rational witness and a unique Galois-unit restriction. Outside the two distinguished objects, the sector with irrational d/D has either 18 objects of dimension 72+12sqrt(37) or 72 objects of dimension 36+6sqrt(37), all with primitive-37 twists. These are sector counts, not total center ranks or counts of all primitive-37 twists. In the 18-object branch, an explicit 19-dimensional modular block forces all products of the 18 objects; every forced coefficient is a nonnegative integer. General unbraided categorification remains unresolved; every braided Morita representative is excluded.

same_category_implications.explanation: The complete oriented sphericalization analysis forces a spherical section: all other signed quotients are excluded by exact dimension-character obstructions, or the positive second-indicator normalization leaves only the original tensor. Thus every hypothetical categorification admits a spherical structure.

existence_implications.explanation: The new sphericalization theorem supplies a spherical structure. Its dimension character lies in the FP Galois orbit, so every categorification has a pseudo-unitary Galois conjugate with the same fusion rules. The original category need not be pseudo-unitary, and unitarity is not established.

General, pivotal, spherical and pseudo-unitary categorifiability are equivalent as existence questions for this ring. Existence itself, including unitary existence, remains open.
categorification_scope.record_scope_note: These statements report established results in the linked research record. Excluding a construction family, an associator choice or an induction frame does not exclude all categorifications with a given structure. The site’s independent-review caution applies to the recorded research proofs.

braided.explanation: The simple FP dimension 5+sqrt(37) is not a d-number: its polynomial is x²−10x−12, and 12 does not divide 100. This contradicts the squared-norm theorem for a pseudo-unitary braided category. Every general categorification has a pseudo-unitary Galois conjugate, and any braiding transports to it. The exclusion therefore requires no initial pivotal structure.

morita.explanation: Every proper fusion subcategory is pointed and the global FP dimension is irrational. A braided Morita representative would therefore give a braiding on this category, by the tensor-image criterion. Hence no categorification of this ring is Morita equivalent to a braided fusion category.

tensor_convention: N[i][j][k] is the coefficient of X_k in X_i * X_j. Indices are zero-based; X_0 is the unit. The supplied source basis is preserved.
hash_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with separators=(',', ':') and no trailing newline. The formatted .txt file has the same tensor, not the same byte hash.
numeric_encoding_note: Exact integers outside the JavaScript safe-integer range (absolute value greater than 9007199254740991) are encoded as decimal strings to preserve every digit in browser display and JSON downloads. Fusion-tensor coefficients remain integers.

invariants.dimensions_method: Numerical Perron eigenvector, normalized at the tensor unit; approximate values.
invariants.character_method: Numerical simultaneous eigencharacters of the integral fusion matrices; approximate values.

exact_character_presentation.exact_generator: theta = Σ_i w_i X_i (character value at a root of P)
exact_character_presentation.instruction: For each complex root θ of P(θ)=0, substitute θ into the displayed polynomials to obtain one exact irreducible character and its formal codegree. All matrix identities N_i=p_i(H) were checked over Q.

invariants.exact_dimension_method: Each FP dimension is the largest real root of its displayed irreducible polynomial, isolated by the rational interval. Factors and intervals are computed exactly from the integral fusion-matrix characteristic polynomial. The global dimension uses the central Casimir matrix.
invariants.fusion_matrix_convention: N_i[j][k] = N[i][j][k]; rows are the right input basis index, columns are the output basis index.
invariants.closed_based_subrings_method: Exhaustive subsets containing the unit, closed under duality and every nonzero fusion-product coefficient. Includes the unit subring and the whole ring.
